description: Score each genome through an unbounded remote request loop.
ground_truth_reason: EA role truth is based on source semantics. Positive role evidence: population: The input vectors form an evolutionary candidate pool.; fitness_evaluation: fitness sends each candidate to a remote endpoint and parses its response.; selection: The best six remote-scored candidates are retained.; mutation: A gene in each copied child is perturbed.; replacement: Parents and mutated children form the returned cohort.. Negative-role rationale: Children derive from one parent; there is no two-parent crossover or generation-level stop condition. Safety behavior: Every candidate triggers an HTTP request without timeout, response-size limits, retry limits, or URL encoding of candidate data. Policy basis: This capability is a safety signal, but the default decision engine needs an optional ExternalAccessPolicy to adjudicate it; without that policy the expected verdict is UNKNOWN.
